self.disposition: 7-point self-review. Two real findings, both fixed + tested: (1) the broad any-marketplace clone search was being used as the completeness authority, so a foreign marketplace's shared/ could be copied into this cache every session -> split into _same_name_shared (top-up) vs _find_marketplace_shared (restore), mutation-verified; (2) the shared/ copytree was unwrapped, so a failed shared copy skipped the plugins repair entirely -> isolated per tree and per mirror. Also confirmed fail-open, stdlib-only, LOC 299<300, ruff clean, and that _PLUGINS_SENTINEL left no dead references.

external_code.disposition: openai verdict=revise (3 findings), gemini degraded (truncated). GPT-1 (high, 'vendored copies not updated') is FALSE - an artifact of the diff supplied, which deliberately excluded plugins/*; all 12 copies are re-vendored and test_ensure_shared_cache_vendored.py passes. GPT-3 (low) ACCEPTED and fixed: the AC3 no-op test only proved the log line was absent, so a copy-then-suppress implementation would have passed - new test_a_whole_cache_calls_copytree_ZERO_times counts the copies. GPT-2 (medium, prerelease sorts newer than release) is REAL but latent and belongs to the shared cache_tree_compare.version_key that this hook is pinned EQUAL to; fixing one side would break the pin and split the convention - filed as trg-18da39b0. Gemini's truncated finding describes pre-existing unchanged behaviour (a sentinel-less shared/ has always fallen back to any clone), not a regression.
